nodes.label: LOWDIN-HANDOFF-44 superset archive (session 44)
nodes.rationale: A single superset archive README is the one document a successor session opens; it supersedes its predecessor rather than amending it, because an older README is sealed history (H.4).

nodes.label: Two-half verification: integrity and completeness (F43.1)
nodes.rationale: bad=0 alone only proves every listed file hashes; it cannot prove the tree holds nothing unlisted. Half B (completeness) is the repair, and the can-fail plants an unlisted file.

nodes.label: F44.1 — gates 79 and 80 named non-gates
nodes.rationale: The old gate 79 text ran a module with no __main__ that exits 0 having compared nothing; gate 80 named symbols living in a different module. A command that exits 0 without comparing anything is not a gate.

nodes.label: F44.2 — margin never quoted without its channel
nodes.rationale: `margin` does not name its runner-up; read order[1]. A margin against an unnamed channel is not a measurement.

nodes.label: BLOCKING s44 — the nlchain configuration column
nodes.rationale: ok and the configuration disagreed at 7 of 10 steps in the 4d row, so a step score (42/47) is not a configuration score and must not be quoted as one.

nodes.label: F38.1 — .json data files must be layered too
nodes.rationale: Omitting the *.json extension from the layering loop loses eps0a_table.json and breaks every importer downstream, silently.
